sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 23.03.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

This is an application seeking interim bail for 30 days w.e.f. 30.03.2023 in FIR No. 551/2021 registered at P.S.Kalkaji u/s 363/ 323/ 344/ 366A/ 370/ 376/377/ 506/ 506/ 120B IPC & 6,12,17 POCSO Act as recorded in the chargesheet.

It is stated that the applicant has two minor children, aged 10 years and 11 years, suffering from various ailments like diabetes, anxiety, Vertigo, partial blindness, spasms of limbs, jaw locking etc and the applicant is required to make administrative, financial and other arrangements for their welfare and education.
For the reasons stated above, issue notice.
Mr. Utkarsh, learned APP accepts notice, seeks and is granted 1 week to file a status report.
Let Nominal Roll be requisitioned from jail authorities.
